theme: Amateur robotics club: conflicting recommendations and qualified opinions

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Kicking off parts for the line-follower build. Which microcontroller board should we standardise on?

messages.author: u-ottilie
messages.text: For beginners, the Kestrel Nano. Simple pinout and great tutorials.

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: I'd go Vireo S3. More pins and wifi, better long term.

messages.author: u-ottilie
messages.text: Vireo is fine for experienced members, but it's overkill for first builds.

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Budget check: we have 400 for the whole season.

messages.author: u-rook
messages.text: Motors: under budget, Bumble gearmotors are the way. If money weren't an issue I'd say Pallas N20 metal gear.

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: Disagree, Bumbles strip their gears fast. I'd still pick the Pallas.

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Venue for build nights: the scout hut on Larch Road?

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Scout hut is great in summer, but it has no heating. In winter it's freezing.

messages.author: u-rook
messages.text: Library makerspace has heating and a soldering bench, but only on Tuesdays.

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Decision for the board: Kestrel Nano for the beginner kits. Advanced members can bring their own Vireo.

messages.author: u-ottilie
messages.text: Batteries: 4xAA packs for beginners. LiPo only for members who've done the safety session.

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: Update on LiPo: I found a cheaper charger, 18 instead of 30.

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Motors decision: Bumble gearmotors for the 8 club kits, keeps us under 400.

messages.author: u-rook
messages.text: Correction to Hana's numbers: we need 10 kits, not 8. Still Bumbles, still under budget.

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Yes, Rook's right, my mistake.

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Venue: scout hut from now until end of September, then library makerspace on Tuesdays for winter.

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: Has anyone used the Corvid line sensor? Is it any good?

messages.author: u-ottilie
messages.text: Wheels: I'd recommend the 65mm rubber ones, at least for smooth floors. On carpet they slip.

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Scout hut just told me they're closing for repairs in September.

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Change of plan: scout hut through August only, library makerspace on Tuesdays from 1 September.

messages.author: u-rook
messages.text: Soldering irons: I can lend two.

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: For what it's worth, I still think Vireo would be better for everyone.

messages.author: u-pell
messages.text: Noted, Devrim, but the decision stands: Kestrel Nano for kits.

messages.author: u-ottilie
messages.text: Which board did we land on for the kits again?

messages.author: u-hana
messages.text: Kestrel Nano for kits, see Pell's decision.

messages.author: u-rook
messages.text: Should we enter the regional line-follower contest in November?

messages.author: u-devrim
messages.text: Maybe, if the robots are working by October.

state.note: s2m02 (Kestrel, for beginners) and s2m03 (Vireo) are conflicting recommendations from different people; s2m11 adopts Kestrel for beginner kits and allows Vireo for advanced members. No pair: the decision adopts a recommendation rather than correcting a claim, and s2m23 is a mere disagreement that s2m24 explicitly rejects.

One-detail correction: 8 -> 10 kits; motor choice (Bumble) unchanged. s2m16 only confirms. s2m07 is a disagreement with s2m06 about motor quality, not a supersession. s2m06 is qualified (under budget vs money no object).

s2m17's switch-over date (end of September) is replaced by 1 September after the scout hut closure news (s2m20). s2m09 and s2m10 are qualified opinions (summer/winter, Tuesdays only), not decisions. s2m13 uses 'update' and 'instead' but adds new info about a charger and corrects nothing.

questions.question: Which microcontroller are the club kits using?
questions.goldAnswer: The Kestrel Nano. Advanced members may bring their own Vireo.
questions.note: Decision s2m11, reaffirmed in s2m24 and paraphrased question answered in s2m26.

questions.question: Is the Vireo S3 the board recommended for beginners?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Ottilie recommended the Kestrel Nano for beginners and said the Vireo is fine only for experienced members.

questions.question: Are we buying motors for 8 kits?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Rook corrected it to 10 kits; still Bumble gearmotors and still under budget.

questions.question: Which motors would Rook pick if money weren't an issue?
questions.goldAnswer: Pallas N20 metal gear motors; under budget he recommends Bumble gearmotors.

questions.question: Where are build nights in September?
questions.goldAnswer: At the library makerspace on Tuesdays from 1 September, because the scout hut closes for repairs.
questions.note: s2m21 replaced the end-of-September switch in s2m17.

questions.question: Can every member use LiPo batteries?
questions.goldAnswer: No. LiPo is only for members who have done the safety session; beginners use 4xAA packs.

questions.question: Did the club switch the kits to Vireo after Devrim objected?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Devrim disagreed, but Pell said the decision stands: Kestrel Nano for kits.
questions.note: Disagreement does not supersede a decision.

questions.question: Is the Corvid line sensor any good?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Devrim asked, but nobody answered.

questions.question: Are we entering the regional contest in November?
questions.goldAnswer: Not decided. Devrim only said maybe, if the robots are working by October.
questions.note: A conditional 'maybe' is not a decision.

questions.question: Will the 65mm rubber wheels work on carpet?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Ottilie recommends them for smooth floors but said they slip on carpet.
questions.note: Recommendation applies to a different condition.

deletionProbe.question: How many kits are we buying motors for?
